facts.fact: 加百列在 EON 的屏幕墙前转着铅笔，扫视车队监视、无人机画面与现场探员头盔的实时影像。
facts.anchor: He spun the pencil between his fingers as he scanned the bay of screens

facts.fact: 现场探员头盔传回的画面里有两路已经黑掉：信号还在，人是死的。
facts.anchor: Of the last, two had gone dark.

facts.fact: 另一块屏幕上，米切尔·特纳昏迷在货车地板上。
facts.anchor: Another screen showed Mitchell Turner, unconscious on a van floor.

facts.fact: 右下角屏幕是伊莱背心摄像头拍下的金发小女孩静帧。
facts.anchor: a grainy still of a small blond girl

facts.fact: 加百列拿西德妮·克拉克举例：她控制不了自己复活的人。
facts.anchor: For example, Sydney Clarke couldn’t control the people she brought back.

facts.fact: 海伦娜现身通报，说增援正在赶往游乐场。
facts.anchor: Reinforcements are on their way to the park.

facts.fact: 马尔科姆把定位打在屏幕上并发到通讯器：MADMAN'S MANSION。
那个苍白的身影一脚踩在镜头上，汽车旅馆的画面就此中断。
facts.anchor: brought his boot down on the lens, killing the feed.
